modmenu.descriptionTranslation.terrafill: Fills a region bottom-up with a build block as fast as possible. Restocks from shulker boxes in the inventory.
terrafill.help.footer: All settings are saved automatically to config/terrafill.json.
terrafill.help.1.desc: corner 1 of the footprint – without arguments the column you stand in
terrafill.help.2.desc: corner 2 – height does not matter, start reads it from the terrain
terrafill.help.3.desc: fix the top (and bottom); default is automatic from the terrain along the edge
terrafill.help.4.desc: go – build block in the slot, shulkers with more of it in the inventory
terrafill.help.5.desc: stop, continue, show progress – resume also works after a restart
terrafill.help.6.desc: hotbar slot holding the build block, default 5
terrafill.help.7.desc: sword, default 1; fights when attacked, heals when health is low
terrafill.help.9.desc: blocks per tick, default 8 (= 160 per second)
terrafill.help.10.desc: only cover water on top (default) or fill it down to the ground
terrafill.help.11.cmd: depot pos1 / pos2 [x y z] | list | clear
terrafill.help.11.desc: storage area with chests: when all shulkers are empty he refills them there
terrafill.help.12.desc: show settings or reset them to defaults
terrafill.help.13.desc: placing reach, default 4.5; the server accepts up to 5.4 – more cells per spot, less walking
terrafill.pos.dimension_reset: Different dimension – the other corner was discarded.
terrafill.height.auto: Height: automatic – top from the terrain along the edge, filled down to the ground.
terrafill.height.top: Height: top %s, depth automatic down to the ground.
terrafill.sword.set: Sword in slot %s. Fights when attacked, heals below 12 health.
terrafill.sword.off: No sword. Mobs are not fought; only the stop below 12 health protects you.
terrafill.food.set: Food in slot %s. Eats at hunger 12.
terrafill.food.off: No food. Stops when hunger drops below 6.
terrafill.water.lid: Water only gets a lid: the top water cell is placed, the water below stays. Applies from the next start.
terrafill.water.fill: Water is filled down to the ground. Applies from the next start.
terrafill.config.line: Build block %s, sword %s, food %s, %s blocks per tick, reach %s, %s.
terrafill.config.no_region: No region set – run /terrafill pos1 and pos2 first.
terrafill.start.no_region: No region – run /terrafill pos1 and /terrafill pos2 first.
terrafill.start.wrong_dimension: The region is in %s, you are in %s.
terrafill.start.too_big: Footprint too big: %s columns, the limit is %s.
terrafill.start.too_many: Too much to fill – more than %s blocks. Shrink the area or limit the depth with /terrafill y.
terrafill.start.height_auto: Top %s from the terrain along the edge, filling down to %s.
terrafill.start.no_block: Hotbar slot %s holds no block. Put the build block there and shulkers with more of it into the inventory.
terrafill.start.ok: Go with %s: footprint %s×%s in %s tiles. Abort with /terrafill stop.
terrafill.tiles: %s tiles of %s×%s, snaking from the nearest corner.
terrafill.tile.travel: Tile %s is not loaded – walking to its centre %s.
terrafill.tile.done: Tile %s of %s done: %s placed, %s taken back by the server, speed now %s per tick.
terrafill.verify: Verification: %s cells still missing, from layer %s (%s of them skipped before).
terrafill.stop.tile_not_loaded: Tile %s at %s does not load – render distance too small?
terrafill.stop.tile_unreachable: No way to tile %s at %s. Walk there and run /terrafill resume.
terrafill.resume.nothing: Nothing to resume. Run /terrafill start first.
terrafill.status.line: Tile %s/%s, layer %s, %s cells open, %s placed (this tile %s of %s), state %s.
terrafill.heal.start: Health at %s – walling myself in and waiting to recover.
terrafill.eat.stuck: Eating from slot %s won't start – carrying on building for now.
terrafill.abort.health: Health below %s and no sword configured.
terrafill.abort.hunger_no_slot: Hunger below 6 and no food slot configured.
terrafill.abort.hunger_empty: Hunger below 6 and food slot %s is empty.
terrafill.stop.losing_health: Health dropping to %s with no enemy in sight.
terrafill.stop.no_regen: No recovery for a minute, health at %s.
terrafill.done_skipped: Done. %s blocks placed, %s tiles, %s unreachable cells skipped.
terrafill.skipped: %s cells at %s are reachable from nowhere – skipped (%s in total).
terrafill.local.start: Stuck at %s – filling the hole here first (%s layers up to Y=%s), then carrying on normally.
terrafill.local.done: Hole filled, back to the layer.
terrafill.approach: No spot reachable – walking as close as possible to %s.
terrafill.stop.stuck: Cannot get past %s. Clear the way and run /terrafill resume.
terrafill.stop.in_water: In the water with no way out within reach (bank higher than one step) from %s. Walk ashore and run /terrafill resume.
terrafill.escape: In the water at %s – heading ashore first, building from there.
terrafill.stop.no_air: Running out of air and no way up from %s. Surface and run /terrafill resume.
terrafill.restock.done: Restock: took %s stacks of %s from the shulker box.
terrafill.restock.empty: Out of %s – none loose and none in a shulker box. Stopped at %s.
terrafill.restock.swap_failed: Could not move the build block into slot %s.
terrafill.restock.no_space: No room next to me for the shulker box.
terrafill.restock.place_failed: Could not place the shulker box.
terrafill.restock.open_failed: Shulker box at %s did not open.
terrafill.restock.no_room: Inventory full – keep at least 2 free slots. The shulker box is at %s.
terrafill.restock.break_failed: Could not break the shulker box at %s.
terrafill.restock.not_picked_up: Cannot pick up the shulker box at %s – inventory full? Collect it yourself, then run /terrafill resume.
terrafill.restock.drop_lost: No shulker item appeared after breaking the box at %s – fell into water? Please check.
terrafill.restock.drop_left: The broken shulker box is still lying at %s – please pick it up.
terrafill.restock.left_behind: The shulker box is still standing at %s – please break it yourself.
terrafill.restock.retry_depot: Restock hiccup: %s – refilling at the depot.
terrafill.depot.count: %s containers loaded in it (chests, barrels, shulkers).
terrafill.depot.none: No depot set – /terrafill depot pos1 and pos2 on the corner chests.
terrafill.depot.too_big: Depot too big: %s blocks, the limit is %s.
terrafill.depot.no_chests: No container found in the depot at %s – not loaded or wrong area.
terrafill.depot.far: Shulkers empty – depot at %s is out of view distance, walking there first.
terrafill.depot.go: Shulkers empty – heading to the depot (%s containers), first chest at %s.
terrafill.depot.unreachable: Chest at %s not reachable, moving on to the next.
terrafill.depot.open_failed: Chest at %s does not open (block on top?), moving on to the next.
terrafill.depot.empty: Nothing of the build block left in the depot.
terrafill.depot.no_room: Inventory full – no room to repack. Keep at least two free slots.
terrafill.depot.done: Depot done: %s shulkers filled, %s stacks repacked. Back to work.
